description: A TransactionRecord's offer history, taken from its SessionEvidenceRecord (Sections 9.3, 9.5, 9A.2). transaction-record-basis.json's two-round session is replayed and this implementation produces both records; the evidence record's transaction_record_hash is the TransactionRecord's record_hash. history_cases give, for each evidence record, what offer_history_from_evidence / offerHistoryFromEvidence returns for the TransactionRecord with did_documents.current: the offer hashes in order, or null and a reason. record_cases give the verdict of verify_transaction_record_reason / verifySessionEvidenceRecordReason with the named DID documents and offer hashes; did_documents.rotated is the same documents with the producer's key renamed, so a signature names a key no document lists (KEY_NOT_FOUND). offer_chain_hash is checked after both signatures. did_documents.partial withholds the producer's DID document: a signature whose signer's document cannot be obtained is checked neither way, like one whose key is not listed, and a definite failure elsewhere is reported ahead of KEY_NOT_FOUND. A record_cases entry carrying record_document checks that record instead of the vector's own.

history_cases.name: paired
history_cases.description: The session's own evidence record: both offers, signed, rounds 1 and 2, the last the final offer.

history_cases.name: not_linked
history_cases.description: An evidence record that verifies but names another TransactionRecord.

history_cases.name: missing_round
history_cases.description: The evidence record lacks the round-1 offer, so the signed rounds do not run 1..N.

history_cases.name: unsigned_offer
history_cases.description: The round-1 offer is recorded as an unsigned observation.

history_cases.name: evidence_not_verified
history_cases.description: The evidence record's record_hash does not recompute.

record_cases.name: record_with_its_history
record_cases.description: The TransactionRecord with the history taken from its evidence record verifies.

record_cases.name: record_alone
record_cases.description: Without its history the record is checked against its final offer alone; both signatures verify first, so only the chain fails.

record_cases.name: record_key_not_listed
record_cases.description: The final offer's signer's document no longer lists the key it signed with.

record_cases.name: evidence_key_not_listed
record_cases.description: The producer's document no longer lists the key its acts and seal were signed with.

record_cases.name: evidence_signer_document_unavailable
record_cases.description: The producer's DID document is withheld: its counteroffer and seal are checked neither way, nothing else fails, so the record ends at KEY_NOT_FOUND.

record_cases.name: evidence_broken_act_and_signer_document_unavailable
record_cases.description: The other party's signed offer carries a broken signature, and the producer's document is withheld. The broken signature is a definite failure and is reported first.

record_cases.name: record_signer_document_unavailable
record_cases.description: The final offer's signer's DID document is withheld; the acceptance verifies, so the record ends at KEY_NOT_FOUND.

record_cases.name: record_broken_acceptance_and_signer_document_unavailable
record_cases.description: The acceptance's signature is broken and the final offer's signer's document is withheld. The broken signature is reported first.
